title: [04/03/2024] - Changes in the Student Common Room Over Five Years

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The plans illustrate the changes in a student common room over a five-year period, comparing the layout from five years ago to the present day.

frame.name: Overall
paragraphs: Overall, the common room has undergone significant modernization, with the addition of various recreational facilities and a reduction in traditional study furniture. The space has been transformed from a purely academic environment to a more versatile area that accommodates both studying and leisure activities.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the furniture arrangement, the most notable change is the reduction in seating capacity for studying. Five years ago, the room contained four large circular tables distributed evenly throughout the space, with each table surrounded by small seats. Currently, only two tables remain, positioned in the center and lower left area of the room. The entrance, which was previously located on the left side, has been relocated to the top of the room, improving accessibility and flow.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In terms of new additions, several modern amenities have been introduced to enhance the student experience and accommodate diverse learning preferences. A tall bookshelf has been installed along the left wall, providing convenient storage and study resources for students. Additionally, the right side of the room now features comfortable green armchairs arranged near a television, creating a dedicated relaxation and entertainment zone. Furthermore, an orange bench specifically designed for laptop use has been strategically positioned, reflecting the growing importance of digital learning in modern education.
